scope_limit: PromotionProof is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing explicitly selected VAMP evidence-coverage objectives for human promotion-readiness review. It does not determine eligibility, rate an employee, recommend or approve promotion, determine remuneration, or create an employment action.
review_pack_title: DIO PromotionProof Controlled Evidence Readiness Pack
human_gate_reason: Promotion eligibility, recommendation, performance rating, remuneration, employment action, approval and final release remain with authorised humans under the applicable institutional process.
